d:
Jackson Galaxy is meeting cats whose naughty antics are turning their owners' lives upside down. From destructive behavior and territorial battles to litter box troubles and unexpected attacks, these feline troublemakers are keeping their families on their toes.
Can Jackson uncover what's behind their wild behavior and help these cats and their owners find a little peace at home?
Watch My Cat from Hell, Season 7, Episodes 1, 4, 7 & 8, and Season 8, Episodes 1, 4, 7 & 9 on Animal Planet India.
